description: An mod inspired by Jet's Better Exploration that takes a less linear approach to changing Minecraft's exploration

mods.name: Guy's Better Exploration
mods.description: Introduces better exploration incentives and rewards, making minecraft's world more exciting!

releases.notes:
**Initial version 1.0, currently only contains the sculker vial item**

- Craftable using Echo Shards, Amethyst Shards and a Glass Bottle
- Takes the player's experience on usage, up to the amount of the first 30 levels / 1395 experience (detailed in each vial's tooltip)
- When full, can be used to gain the experience back in exchange for the item
- A way to store experience, that gives more usage to both the Ancient City structure (Echo Shards), and Amethyst Shards
